DitherStarfield.twinkle: How much each star pulses, 0 (steady) to 1.
DitherStarfield.angle: Direction the stars drift, in degrees as in CSS: 0 is up, 90 right.
DitherStarfield.drift: Drift speed of the nearest layer, in cells per second. 0 holds them still.
DitherStarfield.nebula: Strength of a faint dithered haze behind the stars, 0 to 1.
